{"schema":3,"id":"quietstart.theme-free-gifts","name":"主题免费领好礼三段任务","version":13,"usage":"在「主题」的「我的」页，亲手点击头部「免费领好礼」卡片。轻启依次完成安装并打开应用、打开已安装应用、观看奖励视频三个区域；若打开应用时出现「选择打开方式」，会选择其中一个可见应用。单次打开分别停留 2 秒和 1 秒，视频左上角显示「领取成功」后才点右上角关闭。每个区域达到 15／150／75 次，或连续点击 3 次「换一换」仍无任务，才进入下一段。已确认的安装任务会尝试卸载本次新装应用。金币兑换由用户自行操作；手动返回「我的」页会停止本次三段任务。","appliesTo":["com.huawei.hmsapp.thememanager"],"entryAfterClick":"免费领好礼","entryAfterClickId":"themeToolTitle","entryClickTexts":["免费领好礼"],"rewardStages":{"pageText":"免费领好礼","returnModuleName":"entry","returnAbilityName":"MainAbility","scrollSpeed":800,"listScrollX":0.52,"pageScrollX":0.015,"scrollTop":0.34,"scrollBottom":0.86,"chooserTexts":["选择打开方式"],"chooserMaxReads":9,"chooserPollMs":250,"stages":[{"kind":"install","title":"安装并回到本页面打开应用获100金币","actionText":"安装","openText":"打开","doneText":"已打开","refreshText":"换一换","maxTasks":15,"maxRefreshes":3,"dwellMs":2000,"marketText":"应用市场","marketNameId":"app_name","marketActionId":"download_button_text","marketCloseRegion":[0.83,0.02,0.99,0.11],"cleanupInstalled":true},{"kind":"open","title":"打开应用获10金币","actionText":"打开","doneText":"已打开","refreshText":"换一换","maxTasks":150,"maxRefreshes":3,"dwellMs":1000},{"kind":"video","title":"看视频获20金币","actionText":"去观看","refreshText":"换一换","maxTasks":75,"maxRefreshes":3,"readyText":"领取成功","countdownPattern":"[0-9]+秒后领取奖励","closeRegion":[0.87,0.01,0.97,0.08]}]},"tasks":[]}
